verdicts.note: Pedagogical method book (Graded Course of Violin Playing, 8 books), not a repertoire work; category 'Technique & Scales' is not a catalogue category and Auer's Graded Course is out of scope. Gap check for Auer's own pieces found nothing new: IMSLP's Auer page lists exactly six compositions (Op. 2 Tarantelle de concert, Op. 3 Reverie, Op. 4 Romance, Op. 5 Rhapsodie hongroise, Reverie No. 2, Op. 9 12 Characteristic Preludes) and ru.wikipedia's list of Auer's original compositions agrees (Opp. 2, 3, 4, 5, 9 plus Reverie No. 2, no opus; Op. 9 is for solo violin, publ. 1926). No Op. 1, 6, 7 or 8 of his own exists in either source; all six are already in existing/queued (N1-N3 left as drafted).
